content: Anti-corruption-layer practice (Azure Architecture Center, DevIQ, CodeOpinion): the ACL is layered adapter (protocol, auth, retries) / translator (model mapping) / facade (domain language). Vendor config, credentials, endpoints and headers belong in the adapter layer; the domain sees only a domain-shaped facade. When a second vendor arrives you add a second ACL, not a branch inside the first. Implication for opaque per-provider settings maps: only the owning adapter interprets its own keys.
